column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease three 9-inch round pans, line with parchment and grease the parchment.
Whisk the cake flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda together.
Beat the butter and sugar on high about 3 minutes until creamy.
Add the eggs, egg whites, and vanilla and beat on high about 2 minutes; the mixture may look curdled.
On low speed, mix in the dry ingredients just until combined, then pour in the buttermilk and mix just until smooth.
Divide the batter evenly among the pans and bake 23–26 minutes until a toothpick in the center comes out clean.
Cool the cakes completely in the pans on a wire rack.
